namespace KingZon.Core.DataBase {
 public class BaseEntity { public long Id {get;set;} public virtual DateTime CreateTime {get;set;} }
 public interface ISoftDeletedEntity { bool IsDeleted {get;set;} }
 public abstract class KingZonEntityTypeConfiguration<T> : IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> where T:class { public abstract void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<T> builder); }
 public interface IRepository<T> where T:class { IQueryable<T> Table {get;} T GetById(long id); void Insert(T value); void Insert(IEnumerable<T> values); void Delete(T value); }
 public class Repo<T>(QueryDb db) : IRepository<T> where T:class {
  public IQueryable<T> Table => db.Set<T>(); public T GetById(long id)=>db.Set<T>().Find(id)!;
  public void Insert(T value)=>db.Add(value); public void Insert(IEnumerable<T> values)=>db.AddRange(values); public void Delete(T value)=>db.Remove(value);
 }
 public class CommonService<T>(IRepository<T> repository) where T:class {
  public IQueryable<T> GetAll()=>repository.Table;
  public Task InsertAsync(T value){repository.Insert(value);return Task.CompletedTask;}
  public Task InsertAsync(IEnumerable<T> values){repository.Insert(values);return Task.CompletedTask;}
 }
 public interface IUnitOfWork { Task SaveChangeAsync(); void SaveChange(); }
 public class UnitWork(QueryDb db):IUnitOfWork {public async Task SaveChangeAsync()=>await db.SaveChangesAsync(); public void SaveChange()=>db.SaveChanges();}
}

public class QueryDb(DbContextOptions<QueryDb> options):DbContext(options) {
 protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder model){
  model.ApplyConfiguration(new TechnicalCraftMap()); model.Entity<Technical_CraftOrderVersion>();
  model.ApplyConfiguration(new NodeTemplateMap());model.ApplyConfiguration(new WorkflowTemplateMap());
  model.ApplyConfiguration(new WF_NodeTemplate_ProductionMap());model.ApplyConfiguration(new WF_NodeTemplate_Material_RLMap());
  model.Entity<WF_NodeTemplate_Machine_RL>();model.ApplyConfiguration(new NodeMap());
  model.ApplyConfiguration(new WF_Node_ProductionExtMap());model.ApplyConfiguration(new WF_Node_MachineRLMap());
  model.ApplyConfiguration(new Production_Dispatch_OrderMap());model.ApplyConfiguration(new Production_Material_Receive_DemandMap());
  model.ApplyConfiguration(new Production_Machine_Material_Receive_DemandMap());model.ApplyConfiguration(new WF_Node_ProductionExt_MaterialRLMap());
  model.Entity<WF_NodeLink>().HasKey(x=>new{x.PreviousId,x.NextId});
  model.Entity<WF_NodeLink>().HasOne(x=>x.Previous).WithMany(x=>x.NextLines).HasForeignKey(x=>x.PreviousId);
  model.Entity<WF_NodeLink>().HasOne(x=>x.Next).WithMany(x=>x.PreviousLines).HasForeignKey(x=>x.NextId);
  model.Entity<WF_NodeTemplateLink>().HasKey(x=>new{x.PreviousId,x.NextId});
  model.Entity<WF_NodeTemplateLink>().HasOne(x=>x.Previous).WithMany(x=>x.NextLineTemplates).HasForeignKey(x=>x.PreviousId);
  model.Entity<WF_NodeTemplateLink>().HasOne(x=>x.Next).WithMany(x=>x.PreviousLineTemplates).HasForeignKey(x=>x.NextId);
  model.Entity<WF_NodeTemplate>().HasMany(x=>x.NodePermissionTemplates).WithOne().HasForeignKey(x=>x.NodeTemplateId);
  model.Entity<WF_NodePermission>();model.Entity<WF_Operation>();model.Entity<Base_UnitConversion>();
  model.Entity<Base_Machine>().HasMany(x=>x.CraftRLs).WithOne().HasForeignKey(x=>x.MachineId);
  model.Entity<Base_Machine>().HasMany(x=>x.UserRLs).WithOne().HasForeignKey(x=>x.MachineId);
  model.Entity<KingZon.OLCM.Inventory.Shared.DataBase.Entities.Inventory_Record>().HasMany(x=>x.OccupyList).WithOne().HasForeignKey(x=>x.InventoryRecordId);
  // SQLite does not implement MySQL IF expressions or ambient transactions. Quantity formula fields are not under test here.
  foreach(var entity in model.Model.GetEntityTypes()) foreach(var property in entity.GetDeclaredProperties())
   if(property.GetComputedColumnSql()!=null || property.ValueGenerated==Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.ValueGenerated.OnAddOrUpdate){property.SetComputedColumnSql(null);property.ValueGenerated=Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.ValueGenerated.Never;}
 }
}
